findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "get_file" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_google_search_results, get_page_text, get_page_html, extract_page_data, get_screenshot, get_file · Private data: get_amazon_search_results, get_amazon_product_details, get_amazon_pricing, ask_chatgpt, fast_search, ask_gemini, get_google_search_results, get_page_text, get_page_html, extract_page_data, get_screenshot, get_file, get_walmart_search_results, get_walmart_product_details, get_youtube_search_results, get_youtube_video_metadata, get_youtube_video_subtitles · Public sink: ask_chatgpt · Destructive: get_amazon_search_results, get_amazon_product_details, get_amazon_pricing, ask_chatgpt, fast_search, ask_gemini, get_google_search_results, get_page_text, get_page_html, extract_page_data, get_screenshot, get_file, get_walmart_search_results, get_walmart_product_details, get_youtube_search_results, get_youtube_video_metadata, get_youtube_video_subtitles.
